_source: Building adjacencies and room numbering come from the Wells schematic campus map image (data/schools/wells/campus_map.png) and the official PDF at pdf_url. Cardinal directions (N/S/E/W) below are TRUE cardinal, confirmed against the compass rose drawn in the top-left of the image (true north = RIGHT of the image). The schematic itself is drawn tilted — see map_orientation below.

map_orientation.note: The Wells campus_map.png schematic is drawn tilted ~90° counterclockwise from true north. When reading the image, mentally rotate it 90° clockwise to recover true cardinal directions.

image_to_true_cardinal.image_top: actually WEST in reality (the Gym is drawn at the top of the image but sits on the west side of campus)
image_to_true_cardinal.image_right: actually NORTH in reality (the compass arrow points to the right of the image)
image_to_true_cardinal.image_left: actually SOUTH in reality (H Building drawn at upper-left is really south-west of center)

B.name: B Building
B.position: EAST side of campus (true cardinal). On the campus_map.png schematic, Building B is drawn at the bottom-center / lower-left — the image is rotated ~90° CCW, so what appears 'west' on the schematic is actually east in reality.
B.notes: Main academic building. Enter through the Foyer on the 1st floor. Elevator available near Foyer.

H.name: H Building
H.position: SOUTH-WEST side of campus (true cardinal) — the large curved building. On the campus_map.png it is drawn in the upper-left; because the schematic is rotated ~90° CCW, upper-left corresponds to south-west in reality.
H.notes: Curved building on the south-west side of campus. Elevator available. H1-H12 on 1st floor, H21-H29 on 2nd floor.

E.name: E Building
E.position: NORTH-CENTER side of campus (true cardinal), standalone portable classrooms next to the Band room and the Admin Office. On the campus_map.png they are drawn on the right-center of the image.
E.notes: Standalone portable classrooms near the Admin Office and Band room.

Library.description: Inside B Building (east side of campus), 1st floor — enter through the Foyer.

Counseling.description: B Building (east side), 2nd floor — take stairs or elevator near the Foyer.

Gym.position: WEST side of campus (true cardinal). On the campus_map.png schematic the Gym is drawn at the top-center because the image is rotated ~90° CCW from true north.
Gym.description: Large standalone building on the west side, next to the Lunch Pavilion. Boys and Girls Locker Rooms are attached.

MPR.position: Center of campus, leaning east (true cardinal). Drawn at the bottom-center of the campus_map.png.
MPR.description: Multi-Purpose Room in the center-east of campus. Includes the Stage, Weight Room, and D1.

Lunch Pavilion.position: WEST / NORTH-WEST side of campus (true cardinal), next to the Gym. Drawn at the top of the campus_map.png just to the right of the Gym.
Lunch Pavilion.description: Standalone building next to the Gym on the west side. Includes Kitchen and Restrooms.

Band.position: NORTH side of campus (true cardinal). Drawn at the far right of the campus_map.png because the schematic is rotated.
Band.description: Standalone Band room on the north side of campus, near E Building.

Office.position: NORTH-EAST side of campus (true cardinal). Drawn at the bottom-right of the campus_map.png — the schematic's rotation makes bottom-right = north-east in reality.
Office.description: Main Admin area on the north-east side. Includes Principal, Asst. Principal, Health room, and Student Activities.

Boys Locker Room.description: Attached to the Gym on the west side of campus.

Girls Locker Room.description: Attached to the Gym on the west side of campus.

Weight Room.description: Inside the MPR building, center-east of campus.

Stage.description: Inside the MPR building, center-east of campus.

Foyer.description: Main entrance area of B Building (east side), 1st floor.

subject_locations.Electives: Any building — elective classes can be located throughout campus

navigation_notes: IMPORTANT ORIENTATION NOTE: The campus_map.png schematic is tilted ~90° counterclockwise from true north. On the schematic, the Gym is drawn at the top and B Building is drawn at the bottom-left, but in reality the Gym is on the WEST side of campus and B is on the EAST side. The compass rose in the top-left corner of the image shows the correct true-north direction (right). All cardinal directions below use TRUE cardinal.
H Building is the large curved building on the SOUTH-WEST side of campus (drawn at upper-left of the schematic).
B Building is on the EAST side (drawn at the bottom-left of the schematic) and contains the Library (1F) and Counseling (2F).
The Gym and Lunch Pavilion are side by side on the WEST side of campus (drawn at the top of the schematic).
The MPR (Multi-Purpose Room) is in the center of campus, leaning east.
E Building portable classrooms are on the NORTH-CENTER side near the Admin Office (drawn right-center on the schematic).
The Band room is on the NORTH side of campus (drawn at the far right of the schematic).
The Admin Office (Principal, Asst. Principal, Health) is on the NORTH-EAST side (drawn at the bottom-right of the schematic).
Most buildings have restrooms (RR) marked on the map.
You cannot cut through between B Building and the Office / E Building — to travel between them, you must go around the MPR and through the main quad.
